span.span: FetchAndFilterLogsFromDynatrace (main idea is to reduce token consumption)

div.p: Gets log file, if it has repeated lines of function name and errors, extracts just the service name,file path, error code,line number and error to send it to LLM
Fitlering done for stack trace as well to remove third party framework, give only application error lines

div.span:
Runs git blame on the line given as input, sends output to LLM
ensure it returns only recent changes upto 1month (based on release cycle)

div.div:
If the error message is more generic (null pointer), filter by line number to run git blame on it
If the error message directly found in the code file, return that to run git blame
If the error message not found, then send the lines of code where the issue arises with +-10 lines as context to LLM

div.div: Using slack block kit module, report the issue to a slack channel with 3 lines of summary.

Post 3 actions that will trigger a new workflow:
